subject: Marketplace vendor onboarding MAP — weekly checkpoint and action owner list
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <etorres@resellco.com>, AWS Marketplace Sales <marketplace-aws-sales@amazon.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + reseller MAP kickoff

Hi Elena / AWS team —

Thanks again for setting time last week. Per our MAP we committed to a short weekly checkpoint cadence to keep the marketplace + reseller onboarding on track. Attached is our working MAP (MAP_Roadmap_20261107.xlsx) and an integration checklist we use for marketplace buys.

For this week I want to confirm owners on the three seller purchase paths we discussed:
- AWS Marketplace (direct listing) — primary owner: ResellCo (Elena) + Redwood PM (Sergio)
- Azure Marketplace (reseller flow via ResellCo) — owner: ResellCo legal / Redwood sales (Lauren)
- GCP Marketplace (third-party reseller listing) — owner: GCP partner ops + Redwood infra (Camila)

Action items for this message:
1) Elena, can you confirm whether ResellCo needs a reseller agreement redline before we submit the AWS listing?
2) AWS team — any gating items on SBOM/KMS before we can enable procurement?
3) Sergio — please call out any infra-side prerequisites (billing alias, private offer setup).

I'll consolidate replies and send a short meeting note after Wednesday's checkpoint.

Thanks —
Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (612) 555-0146

Attachments: MAP_Roadmap_20261107.xlsx (spreadsheet), aws_marketplace_integration_checklist.pdf (doc)

From: Elena Torres <etorres@resellco.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Sales <marketplace-aws-sales@amazon.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + reseller MAP kickoff

Camila —

Thanks for the MAP. Quick answers below:  
1) Reseller agreement: We prefer to get a fully redlined copy before listing to avoid surprises on revenue share and tax handling. I can send our preferred changes today.
2) SBOM/KMS: Our security lead flagged SBOM for AWS as "required for production listing" but KMS can be handled post-listing if the private offer flow is used. I'll loop in our security contact if needed.
3) Reseller owners: Confirming I'll be the primary owner for the reseller coordination and will work the legal redline with Redwood and AWS.

We should also confirm timeline windows — end of November was the ask from procurement on their side; we'll aim for a soft-launch on Dec 7 if contract and AWS checks clear.

Regards,
Elena
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, ResellCo
etorres@resellco.com
+1 (415) 555-2190

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <etorres@resellco.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + reseller MAP kickoff

Camila / Lauren —

Notes from my side after reviewing the MAP document:  
- Billing alias: We need the ResellCo billing alias (AWS account id) to configure private offers. ETA from your side: 48 hours once provided.
- Deployment packaging: For marketplace we need a container image with minimal runtime and a lightweight inference shim; infra can provide a template (I can share).
- SBOM: We'll add a short SBOM export to the artifacts bundle; can produce within 3 business days but need third-party deps list from your engineering team.

Quick action list for internal owners:  
- Sergio: prepare container template + SBOM script (owner: me) — due 2026-11-10
- Lauren: lead legal loop + negotiate reseller clause in the contract (owner: Lauren) — due 2026-11-12
- Camila: coordinate marketplace listings and confirm private offer requirements with AWS/GCP teams (owner: Camila) — due 2026-11-09

I'll push the infra checklist to the shared MAP spreadsheet.

- Sergio

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <etorres@resellco.com>, AWS Marketplace Sales <marketplace-aws-sales@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + reseller MAP kickoff — weekly checkpoint notes

Team —

Short meeting notes from today (consolidated):
- Timeline: Elena requested end-of-Nov contract completion; ResellCo aiming for Dec 7 soft launch. We agreed to prioritize AWS private offer flow to unblock procurement quickly.
- Legal: Lauren to circulate redline by EOD Monday 11/09. If ResellCo accepts, we push to DocuSign and start AWS private offer submission.
- Infra: Sergio to deliver container template + SBOM script by 11/10. Camila to validate image against marketplace constraints.
- Procurement gating: AWS needs SBOM and billing alias; ResellCo to provide account id and preferred tax handling.

Action items (owner — due):
- ResellCo: send reseller redline + AWS account id — Elena — due 2026-11-09
- Lauren: circulate redline and proposed clause language — Lauren Bishop — due 2026-11-09
- Sergio: template + SBOM script pushed to MAP spreadsheet and shared drive — Sergio Alvarez — due 2026-11-10
- Camila: confirm private offer steps with AWS and open private offer ticket if needed — Camila Reyes — due 2026-11-09

Next checkpoint: weekly sync on Monday 2026-11-09 at 10:00 PT — 30 minutes. I'll send calendar invite.

Camila

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <etorres@resellco.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + reseller MAP kickoff — weekly checkpoint notes

Thanks all — quick confirmation:  
- I'll have the initial redline comments uploaded to the MAP spreadsheet by COB Monday (11/09).
- On the reseller clause: I'll propose a short-term carve that keeps revenue share flat for first 90 days and then re-evaluates — I'll flag this clearly for ResellCo legal.
- If ResellCo can provide the AWS account id today/tomorrow we can keep the Dec 7 soft launch target.

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
note: All internal participants listed are employees whose mailboxes exist under sources/gmail; external participants are partners and marketplace contacts.
